summary: Max Verstappen commands the sand dunes of Zandvoort one last time as Red Bull hunts another victory on home soil, with championship rivals circling to exploit any vulnerability in the team's dominance. Hadjar's wrist injury forces Red Bull into a seat-fitting scramble, potentially disrupting their setup preparations during this final Dutch Grand Prix before the circuit's F1 farewell. A strong performance here could prove decisive in the title race as the grid heads into the season's decisive stretch with Zandvoort's emotional final bow adding weight to every position gained.
